name: Ore
description: Raw stone and metal, hauled up from the guild’s own quarry pit.

name: Timber
description: Felled and split lumber, stacked to season by the woodyard.

name: Herbs
description: Cuttings and roots from the herb garden -- the backbone of every potion.

name: Food
description: Whatever the day’s supply run brings in -- the catch off the dock, salted meat, foraged berries. Anything that keeps a hero fed on the road.
